newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore RSS3 rubber futures trade slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Singapore RSS3 rubber futures trade slightly lower.

text.p: Singapore RSS3 rubber futures were traded slightly lower in moderate trade on local two-way business, brokers said on Wednesday.

"The market was dead as usual today except for some light two-way trade in the January RSS3 contract between 127.00 and 127.25 U.S. cents a kg. Volume was moderate. The RSS1 and TSR20 contracts were untraded but were indicated at slightly lower levels," a local broker said
"It's been a very quiet market. There's no incentives, no activity in the ring session or Chinese or Thai enquiries and most people are sitting on the sidelines," another broker said.
At around 0445 GMT, January RSS3 eased half a cent to 127.25 cents a kg.
January RSS1 was indicated at 183.00 Singapore cents (US$1.30) a kg compared with Tuesday's settlement of 184.50 cents.
January TSR20 was indicated at 176.25 Singapore cents (US$1.25) against 177.25 cents.
